title: Supplies for the Voyage

intro.speaker: mara
intro.text: Ahoy! We sail with the tide this evening, and the ship needs her stores.

intro.speaker: mara
intro.text: Here's the list. Read it carefully: at sea, you can't pop back to the shop!

steps.speaker: mara

outro.speaker: mara
outro.text: Thank you, shipmate! The sailors in the Bible trusted God on the wild sea. We will too.

journal_line: At the harbour, I read Captain Mara's list and loaded the ship's stores.
